statement_html: Let \(f\) be the function defined by \(f{\left(x \right)} = \operatorname{Arcsin}{\left(\frac{1 - 2 x}{x + 3} \right)}\). The definition domain of \(f\) is composed of disjoint intervals.
hint_html: What is the definition domain of the function \(\text{Arcsin}\) ?	  You can draw the graph of \(x\rightarrow \frac{1 - 2 x}{x + 3}\) et check by computation.
